english.title: Produce / furnish / sign / make a false s.20 document in an application to be exempt from a s.16(2)(b) or (3A) duty
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in connection with an application under Section 20 of the Football Spectators Act 1989 to be exempted from any duty under Section 16(2)(b) and (3A) of the said Act, produced, furnished, signed or otherwise made use of a document which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular or recklessly produced, furnished, signed or otherwise made use of a document which was false or misleading in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY THE PARTICULARS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(10)(b) and (11) of the Football Spectators Act 1989.
